metadata.title: Thevo Chu | Pork with bamboo shoots | Naga style
metadata.description: Thevo Chu or pork with bamboo shoots is an Angami Naga pork dish that is made with fresh pork. This dish is commonly made in Naga household and is served with steamed rice.
